主要内容: On February 17, 2014, the Board of Directors of Insperity, Inc. further amended and restated the company’s Amended and Restated Bylaws to eliminate the prohibition of compensatory arrangements with third parties as a qualification for service as a director, provided such arrangements must be disclosed in writing to the company. The amendment allows for compensatory arrangements but requires written disclosure to the company. This change reflects a shift in the company’s governance policy regarding director compensation and third-party arrangements. The full text of the amended bylaws is included as Exhibit 3.1 to this filing, dated February 17, 2014. The amendment does not directly impact the company’s financial performance or stock price but may influence internal governance practices and director responsibilities. The change was approved by the board and signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel, and Secretary, on February 18, 2014.
